scripts.build: pnpm --filter ember-tracked-as-function-polyfill build && pnpm --filter v2-addon build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter ember-tracked-as-function-polyfill lint && pnpm build && pnpm --filter vite-app lint:types
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm --filter ember-tracked-as-function-polyfill test && pnpm --filter "./test-apps/**" --workspace-concurrency=1 test
